narrative.overview: Quiet, photographic, understated, minimal, modern and bespoke native Still. Graphite default, Atelier top navigation, selected filled-corner identity and sharp vector wordmark. Wide native review resolves titlebar/headings and returns ship for the scored View contrast fix only; compact and broader accessibility remain unverified.
keyCharacteristics: Native functional text and keyboard/menu behavior
Top navigation with optional folders, filters and details
Explicit constraints, coverage, availability and photo/file semantics

rules.name: The Photograph Rule
rules.body: Decorative color stays out of the archive canvas.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: Actions remain understandable through text, tooltips, menus and accessible names.

dos: Do use exact source colors and selected vector identity.
Do review native dark/light and compact/wide states.
donts: Don't restore a permanent navigation rail.
Don't treat old canvas captures as redesign approval.
